description: Use this when the person needs a deliverable, often something their champion will carry into meetings the person won't be in (a business case for the CFO, an email draft, a board deck), or asks what Andru can make. Searches Andru's catalog of 139 sales, hiring, fundraising and buying assets. Each entry says what it is, the business outcome, its price, whether it needs the person's own data, and whether it can be generated today. Then call generate_asset with the asset's name.

available_only.description: Only assets that can be generated today.

query.description: Keywords for what you need, e.g. 'board deck', 'buying committee', 'first sales hire'.

name: list_assets
title: Search the asset catalog
